name: SporkMoney
description: I wanted to be less poor and know exactly how much I could afford to blow each day. So I built it. Plaid integration syncs all my accounts, and projection math handles daily allowance, savings runway, and emergency-fund timelines.

cat.name: Spork
cat.caption: Yes, the budget app is named after him.

name: Streamour
description: The streaming sites I was using were slow, kept buffering, and the subtitles were never in sync. So I built my own. MKV-to-HLS conversion for desktop and mobile, cookie auth, middleware-protected routes, and partial content delivery for clean seeking.

cat.name: Seymour
cat.caption: The streaming app is named after him.
